rv.q: Anyone with a theatrical bone in their body will be thrilled by experiencing this genuinely great actor at the height of his powers.
“All the Devils Are Here” is a truly remarkable experience that is as multifaceted and expertly connived as the villains it portrays.
To attend this performance is to be immersed in a master class of storytelling and acting.

cn.t: Patrick Page delivers a spectacular performance at the height of his powers, thrilling audiences as he exposes the psyches of Shakespeare's villains in this acclaimed one-man show that tackles timeless questions about wickedness.
